correctness.rationale: All normalized degree-three generators of the 40-element and 70-element conjugacy quandles are exhaustively enumerated. A self-contained standard-library checker verifies quandle identities, the integer equation d2*d3=0, connectedness (so rank d2=m-1), and exact F2/F3 boundary ranks 1520/1519 and 4761/4759 respectively, with an independent pivot-order replay for all characteristic-two and for the n=6 characteristic-three case. Dimension = m(m-1) - (m-1) - rank(d3). The five-letter control agrees with the published group. For the integral primary-generator conclusion, H1 of connected quandle is Z and H2 over Q vanishes by the finite connected-quandle rational rank theorem, so universal coefficients give primary ranks exactly; no torsion exponents or untested primes are claimed.

value.rationale: The two excluded symmetric-group degrees arise from genuinely exceptional Schur-multiplier behavior and are natural missing objects in a recent classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The exact pair of small-prime dimensions identifies two independent three-primary second-homology generators in each exceptional quandle and distinguishes their two-primary behavior, informing the existence/count of possible quandle 2-cocycle classes and extension constructions. The finite coefficient result is mathematically well-defined and independently motivated without asserting a full integral classification.
